rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Председателя Правительства — Acting Chairman of the Government
rows.text: 'В связи с вступлением в должность Президента Российской Федерации', Decree No. 834 entrusts the performance of the duties of the Chairman of the Government to the First Deputy Chairman of the Government and Minister of Finance, Kasyanov Mikhail Mikhailovich; it enters into force from the moment of signature; signed 'Президент Российской Федерации В.Путин', Moscow, Kremlin, 7 May 2000, No. 834.

bounded_scope: Chairman of the Government observations for CLAUDE-C01-19 only. Nomination, presentation at a sitting, parliamentary consent, approval or refusal, votes, appointment, the Government's resignation, dismissal or laying down of powers, continued duties, acting service and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
